Inter, Google Fonts release v20, weights 400 / 500 / 600 / 700 (normal style), vendored for Mason on 2026-11-18
(UIFIX2 item 3).

Why: templates/mason_v2.html and ui/harness.html loaded the font from Google Fonts. It now ships with Mason, so
the page looks the same with no internet and the public repository has no CDN dependency.

Source:
  stylesheet  https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap
              (as sent to Chrome on 2026-11-18; that is what the page asked for, and nothing else: no italics,
              no other weights)
  font files  the 7 files that stylesheet names, one per alphabet range. Each is one "variable" file that holds
              all four weights, which is why 28 @font-face blocks point at only 7 files.
    inter-v20-cyrillic-ext.woff2  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa2JL7SUc.woff2
    inter-v20-cyrillic.woff2      https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa0ZL7SUc.woff2
    inter-v20-greek-ext.woff2     https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa2ZL7SUc.woff2
    inter-v20-greek.woff2         https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1pL7SUc.woff2
    inter-v20-vietnamese.woff2    https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa2pL7SUc.woff2
    inter-v20-latin-ext.woff2     https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa25L7SUc.woff2
    inter-v20-latin.woff2         https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7.woff2
  inter.css   Google's stylesheet with a 4-line header added and each of the 28 font addresses replaced by the
              file name above (./inter-v20-<range>.woff2). Nothing else differs: same 28 @font-face blocks, same
              unicode-range lines, same font-display: swap.
How verified: Google publishes no checksums for these files, so the check is by behaviour. The files were fetched
over https from fonts.gstatic.com, the hashes below were recorded at download, and the page was rendered in
headless Chromium once with Google Fonts and once with these files and every outside host blocked: same font
picked for every text element and same text widths (see the UIFIX2 report). All 7 alphabet ranges are kept, so a
headline in Greek, Cyrillic or Vietnamese looks as it did. A browser fetches a range only when the page shows a
character from it; an English-only page loads inter-v20-latin.woff2 (48 KB) and nothing else.

Project: https://rsms.me/inter/  ·  https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Inter

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, add a new versioned folder and change the link tag at the top of
templates/mason_v2.html and of ui/harness.html.
